name: datadog
description: Installs every skill from datadog-labs/agent-skills, the CLI tools those skills drive, and a sandbox network policy that allows all Datadog domains.

skills.notes: Every directory containing a SKILL.md is installed. Names that collide across directories (the k8s-ssi and linux-ssi variants of agent-install, enable-ssi, verify-ssi, troubleshoot-ssi and onboarding-summary) are disambiguated with their parent directory.

node.description: dd-apps (Datadog Apps scaffolding) and `npx skills`. Datadog requires Node.js 20.19+.

k8s.description: dd-apm k8s-ssi skills (agent-install, enable-ssi, verify-ssi, troubleshoot-ssi, onboarding-summary).

gh.description: dd-software-delivery unblock-pr, which falls back to `gh run rerun` when the Datadog MCP server is unavailable.

python.description: agent-observability experiment/eval skills, which generate and run ddtrace.llmobs code. Installed into a dedicated venv so the system interpreter is left alone.

datadog.description: Every Datadog site and every Datadog-owned apex domain, including subdomains. This is the policy the kit writes into Claude Code's sandbox settings.

toolchain.description: Only needed while install.sh downloads the CLI tools. Deliberately kept out of settings.json — apply settings.install.json instead if you run the installer from inside a sandboxed shell.

mcp.description: Optional. Several skills prefer the Datadog MCP server over the pup CLI; agent-observability requires it. Installed only with --with-mcp, and each server still needs an interactive OAuth login.
